# GKR Hospitality

> Hospitality operations consultancy based in New York, NY. Founded by Garrett
> Ronan, a hospitality operator with more than 30 years of US and international
> experience. GKR works with hotels, restaurants, private members clubs,
> nightlife and event venues from concept and capital raising through design,
> construction and opening, and into day-to-day operations.

GKR Hospitality is an operator-led consultancy, not an agency. Engagements are
run on property rather than remotely wherever the work calls for it. Typical
engagements run 3 to 6 months for operations and revenue audits, and 6 to 12
months for concept-to-opening projects. Pricing is quoted a la carte after a
complimentary discovery call.

## Services
- **Concept Creation**: Ideation, positioning, market and competitive research,
  site identification and sourcing.
- **Capital & Growth Investment**: Growth capital sourcing, mergers and
  acquisitions support, investor-ready business plans and models.
- **Design, Development & Construction**: Owner's representative oversight,
  schematic design coordination, value engineering, contract review, RFP and
  bidding management, FF&E and specialty coordination, cost control.
- **Operations**: Pre-opening planning and standards, launch support,
  post-opening stabilisation, SOP creation, full operational audits and secret
  shops, sales and marketing, revenue management, HR and recruitment, labor
  relations and union negotiations, procurement, F&B menu engineering.
- **Legal**: Lease review and negotiation, licensing and permitting, contract
  negotiation, employment and labor support.
- **Financial**: Budgeting and forecasting, financial audits, cost control
  systems, profitability analysis, M&A support, sale and exit preparation.
- **Fractional COO and C-suite support** for operators without in-house
  senior leadership.

## Founder
Garrett Ronan. Previously COO at BLACE, US COO at etc.venues (launched the US
market, opened three NYC venues, merged with Convene), VP Hotel Operations &
Development at Starr Restaurants (F&B and events for the first Equinox Hotel at
Hudson Yards), and VP Operations & Development at Azumi/Zuma (US expansion
across six markets for Zuma, Etaru and Inko Nito). Earlier senior leadership at
Waldorf Astoria, The Beverly Hilton, Boston Harbor Hotel, Principal Hotels UK,
Adare Manor and Mövenpick.
